what are the exclusions applicable for  travel insurance

Travel Protect360 (travel insurance) has General Exclusions and also section-wise exclusions. As per the policy, it generally does not cover events that arise from: professional sports/racing, suicide or self-inflicted injury, pregnancy/miscarriage/childbirth/abortion and related complications, being under the influence of alcohol/drugs (except as prescribed), venereal disease/HIV and related illnesses, proceeding with the trip against a doctor’s advice, and epidemic/pandemic (WHO/Ministry of Health of Singapore declared) except where COVID-19 cover is specifically applicable in the policy sections. It also excludes activities like military/naval/air force/police services, certain extreme sports/trekking above 3,000 metres, and flying/aerial activities except as a fare-paying passenger in a regular scheduled commercial airline.

If you tell me which cover you’re interested in (like cancellation, postponement, curtailment, or disruption), I can list the specific exclusions for that section as mentioned in the policy.
What are the countries this travel insurance is not applicable to?

The policy doesn’t list “not applicable to specific countries” in the exclusions text. Instead, the exclusions are based on the nature of the activity/event (so coverage won’t apply when those excluded situations happen anywhere).

For example, it excludes events like racing/professional sport, suicide/self-inflicted injury, pregnancy/childbirth-related complications, alcohol/drug influence (except prescribed), HIV/venereal diseases, proceeding against a doctor’s advice, epidemic/pandemic (with specific COVID-19 section carve-outs), warlike activities (naval/military/air force/police services), and flying except as a fare-paying passenger in a regular scheduled commercial airline.

If you share which sections you bought (like medical/ trip cancellation/ disruption), I’ll confirm the relevant country/region applicability and the exact exclusions for those sections from the policy wording.
